title: Butter Chicken
subtitle: Mughlai chicken in a creamy tomato and spice sauce
excerpt: The great restaurant-style Indian curry: chicken marinated in yoghurt and spices, grilled until lightly charred, then finished in a glossy, cream-enriched tomato and butter sauce with fenugreek and garam masala. Rich, aromatic, and deeply satisfying.

recipe.sourceNotes: Butter chicken (murgh makhani) was created in the 1950s at the Moti Mahal restaurant in Delhi by Kundan Lal Gujral and his son Kundan Lal Jaggi. The dish originated from a practical solution: leftover tandoori chicken was added to a rich tomato, butter, and cream sauce to create a dish that could be served at any time without fresh grilling. The sauce is built from a base of blended onion, tomato, and cashews (for richness), cooked with ginger, garlic, and a blend of aromatic spices, then enriched with cream and finished with kasoori methi (dried fenugreek leaves) which gives the sauce its characteristic slightly bitter, aromatic quality. Unlike many Indian curries, butter chicken is intentionally mild and creamy, designed for broad palatability.

content.text: The fenugreek leaves (kasoori methi) added at the end are what distinguishes restaurant-quality butter chicken from home imitations; they are available from any Indian food shop and worth seeking out. Cashews blended into the sauce base add richness and body. Marinating the chicken for at least 4 hours gives the best flavour and colour.

items.preparation: soaked in warm water for 30 minutes; blended smooth
dried; kasoori methi; crushed between the palms

content.text: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, half the garam masala, and the remaining spices. Marinate for at least 4 hours. Grill or cook in a hot pan until lightly charred. Set aside.

Melt the butter in a pan. Cook the onion for 12 minutes until deep golden. Add the garlic and ginger. Cook for 2 minutes. Add the tinned tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend with the cashew paste until very smooth.

Return the blended sauce to the pan. Add the remaining garam masala, cream, and grilled chicken. Simmer for 10 minutes. Crush the dried fenugreek leaves and stir them in. Taste and season. Serve with naan or basmati rice.
